name: Joshua Tree National Park
policyReason: Pets must stay within 100 feet of roads, picnic areas and campgrounds; no hiking trails.
summary: Pets must stay within 100 feet of roads, picnic areas and campgrounds; no hiking trails.

excerpts.quote: Pets are not allowed on hiking trails, in the backcountry, or in park buildings.

dogRules.text: Never more than 100 ft from a road, picnic area or campground.
Paved Oasis of Mara and Keys View trails allow pets.
